gap: Weather Policy Scupper’s Watersports does not operate in unsafe weather conditions, but a light rain shower is not a deterrent. The Captain will assess the weather and should the Captain determine that the conditions are unsafe to run the tour, the tour may be postponed or it will be canceled. If you are unable to reschedule, you will have the option of receiving a voucher for a future trip or receiving a full refund.

quotes.text: A great way to spend our last day in Islamorada and the Florida Keys in general. The crew was hilarious and the vessel was clean and hospitable. 10/10, would absolutely recommend to anyone looking for a great time on the water.

Wonderful guided jet ski tour with Jacob at Bakers Cay resort! We got to see some of the set from one of our favorite Netflix shows, Bloodline, and had so much fun riding in the process. We certainly recommend the experience.
